# Pull Request

## 📋 Description
Brief description of the changes and their purpose.

## 🔧 Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix/feature causing existing functionality to break)
- [ ] 📚 Documentation update
- [ ] 🎨 Style/formatting changes (no functional changes)
- [ ] ♻️ Code refactoring (no functional changes)
- [ ] ⚡ Performance improvement
- [ ] 🔒 Security enhancement

## 🚨 Emergency Use Impact
How does this change affect emergency flood monitoring scenarios?
- [ ] Improves emergency response capabilities
- [ ] Maintains existing emergency functionality
- [ ] No impact on emergency use
- [ ] **Requires testing in emergency scenarios**

## ✅ Testing Checklist
- [ ] Tests pass locally (`npm test`)
- [ ] Type checking passes (`npm run type-check`)
- [ ] Linting passes (`npm run lint`)
- [ ] Build succeeds (`npm run build`)
- [ ] Manual testing completed
- [ ] Mobile responsiveness verified
- [ ] Accessibility tested (keyboard navigation, screen reader)
- [ ] Performance impact assessed

## 📱 Mobile & Accessibility
- [ ] Touch targets are minimum 44px
- [ ] Readable on small screens
- [ ] Works with screen readers
- [ ] Keyboard navigation functional
- [ ] High contrast mode compatible
- [ ] Works offline (if applicable)

## 🌐 API Integration
- [ ] Environment Agency API integration tested
- [ ] Weather API integration tested
- [ ] Error handling implemented
- [ ] Rate limiting respected
- [ ] Caching strategy appropriate
- [ ] Data validation added

## 📊 Performance
- [ ] Page load time under 2 seconds
- [ ] Core Web Vitals maintained
- [ ] Bundle size impact minimal
- [ ] API response times acceptable
- [ ] Memory usage reasonable

## 🔗 Related Issues
Closes #(issue number)
Related to #(issue number)

## 📸 Screenshots
Add screenshots for UI changes, especially mobile views.

## 🧪 Testing Instructions
1. Step-by-step instructions for testing the changes
2. Include specific test cases for emergency scenarios
3. Note any special setup requirements

## 📝 Additional Notes
Any additional context, concerns, or areas needing special attention.

---

## Reviewer Checklist
- [ ] Code follows project style guidelines
- [ ] Changes are well documented
- [ ] No sensitive data exposed
- [ ] Error handling is appropriate
- [ ] Performance impact acceptable
- [ ] Emergency use cases considered
- [ ] Mobile experience verified
